title: Sex by Age by Educational Attainment for the Population 18 Years and Over
geography: United States, the 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico; Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands take the median of the 50 states and D.C.
quote: B15001_001 Total: 258,742,302 for 0100000US (the United States row of acsdt5y2023-b15001.dat).
limits: Estimates only (margins are in the source file). Age bands are 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-64 and 65 and over, so they do not line up with the CES bands 18-29 and 30-44 the opening profile reads; 45-64 and 65 and over match. studyGroupShares groups the seven attainment rows the way the CES 2024 education categories do: no-college is less than high school or a diploma, some-college is some college or an associate degree, college is a bachelor degree or more. A check on totals, never a draw for one person.
